summary_ja: マチュリティ・ラダーを用いた、期間帯内・ゾーン内・ゾーン間の相殺とディスアローアンスの算出手順を定める。
summary_en: Prescribes the steps of the maturity method: building a maturity ladder, then offsetting within time bands, within zones and between zones and computing disallowances.
paragraphs: The method of calculation under the maturity method shall be as prescribed in the following items: (i) A maturity ladder (meaning a table used in calculating the amount of general market risk of the interest rate risk category using the maturity method, for classifying the transactions concerned by residual maturity, etc. for calculation; the same applies hereinafter in this Article) consisting of the thirteen or fifteen time bands set forth in the table in item (ii)(a) of the preceding Article shall be prepared for each currency, and long positions or short positions in debt instruments, etc. shall be entered into the maturity ladder; (ii) The long positions or short positions within each time band multiplied by the risk weight prescribed in the table in item (ii)(a) of the preceding Article shall be offset against each other, and the net position within each time band shall be calculated. In this case, the amount obtained by multiplying the offsetting portion by 10% shall be the amount of vertical disallowance; (iii) The net positions within each time band calculated under the preceding item shall be offset within each zone in the same table as prescribed in the table in item (iii) of the preceding Article, and the net position for each zone shall be calculated. In this case, the amount obtained by multiplying the offsetting portion by the ratio prescribed in that table shall be the amount of horizontal disallowance; (iv) The net positions for each zone calculated under the preceding item shall be offset between zones as prescribed in the table in item (iii) of the preceding Article. In this case, the amount obtained by multiplying the offsetting portion by the ratio prescribed in that table shall be the amount of horizontal disallowance, and the amount remaining through the offsetting under items (ii) through this item shall be the amount of the overall net position in debt instruments, etc.; (v) For currencies with a small scale of dealing, a single maturity ladder may be used collectively. However, offsetting positions of different currencies or different time bands shall not be offset.
